description.value: Raven's River Rest is an Indigenous-owned riverside cabin and healing retreat situated along the Somass River within the traditional Tseshaht Territory near Port Alberni. Created by a Tseshaht couple on ancestral land, it offers guests access to salmon fishing, swimming, and berry picking alongside traditional healing ceremonies, Reiki, and herbal remedy workshops. A touring cyclist staying here would experience a deeply nature-connected, culturally distinctive escape far removed from standard hotel accommodation.
